catalog.description: Copy an existing asset, by sha256 hash at a given revision, from a knowledge base you can read into this one at a path. Same commit rules as knowledge_assets_put.
catalog.name: knowledge_assets_import

catalog.description: List assets with their path, hash, size and MIME type. Reads main unless rev pins a commit. Paginated: pass nextCursor back as cursor.
catalog.name: knowledge_assets_list

catalog.description: Add a finished upload as an asset at a path. Pass the baseRevision you read and an idempotencyKey. Write access commits to main; propose-only access commits to your automatic pull request.
catalog.name: knowledge_assets_put

catalog.description: Create a new knowledge base from a name, URL slug and description. Available only when the credential was approved to create knowledge bases.
catalog.name: knowledge_bases_create

catalog.description: Tombstone a knowledge base. Owner only; requires the current metadataVersion and confirm "DELETE".
catalog.name: knowledge_bases_delete

catalog.description: Get one knowledge base's metadata (name, description, head revision, metadataVersion, capabilities) and its search-index status.
catalog.name: knowledge_bases_get

catalog.description: List the knowledge bases this credential can read, with each one's ID, name, head revision and your capabilities. Paginated: pass nextCursor back as cursor.
catalog.name: knowledge_bases_list

catalog.description: Rename a knowledge base or change its description. Pass the current metadataVersion from knowledge_bases_get; a stale version is rejected.
catalog.name: knowledge_bases_update

catalog.description: Apply up to 32 document and asset changes as one atomic commit. Each successful call commits: apply the first 32 changes now, then send the rest in another call using the returned commit as baseRevision. Mode "edit" takes create, replace, delete, assetPut and assetRemove operations; mode "dream" writes a consolidation of the listed source sessions. Pass the baseRevision you read and an idempotencyKey. Write access commits to main; propose-only access commits to your automatic pull request. To update your open pull request, pass its head or current main as baseRevision: against main it moves onto main if main moved, and a CONFLICT lists any paths to write in full (rewriting a path the pull request changed also needs its proposalNumber, with proposalHeadSha set to the head you read). Never write secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) as plain text: store them as sealed values and write only the sealed reference.
catalog.name: knowledge_changes_apply

catalog.description: Create one Markdown document at a new path. Pass the baseRevision you read and an idempotencyKey. Write access commits to main; propose-only access commits to your automatic pull request. Never write secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) as plain text: store them as sealed values and write only the sealed reference.
catalog.name: knowledge_documents_create

catalog.description: Delete one Markdown document. Requires confirm "DELETE", the baseRevision you read and an idempotencyKey. Write access commits to main; propose-only access commits to your automatic pull request.
catalog.name: knowledge_documents_delete

catalog.description: Read one Markdown document by path: raw Markdown, parsed front matter, the commit it was read at, citations and referenced assets. Reads main unless rev pins a commit.
catalog.name: knowledge_documents_get

catalog.description: List Markdown document paths, optionally under a path prefix. Reads main unless rev pins a commit. Paginated: pass nextCursor back as cursor.
catalog.name: knowledge_documents_list

catalog.description: Replace one existing Markdown document's full content. Pass the baseRevision you read and an idempotencyKey. Write access commits to main; propose-only access commits to your automatic pull request. Never write secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) as plain text: store them as sealed values and write only the sealed reference.
catalog.name: knowledge_documents_update

catalog.description: Show the embedding provider and revision used for semantic search, with the index status.
catalog.name: knowledge_embedding_profile_get

catalog.description: Switch the embedding provider, which rebuilds the search index. Pass a registered providerId with its revision, or providerId "builtin" for the built-in model (revision optional). Requires confirm "RUN".
catalog.name: knowledge_embedding_profile_set

catalog.description: Release a prepared export after you finish reading it.
catalog.name: knowledge_export_complete

catalog.description: Prepare a ZIP export: kind "whole" for documents and assets, or "assets" for assets only. Returns a transferId to read with knowledge_transfer_read and release with knowledge_export_complete.
catalog.name: knowledge_export_prepare

catalog.description: Request a full rebuild of the search index. Requires confirm "RUN".
catalog.name: knowledge_index_rebuild

catalog.description: Show whether the search index is current: indexed commit versus head, build state, freshness and any error code.
catalog.name: knowledge_index_status

catalog.description: Open a pull request from a branch you own into main. Pass the expected head and main SHAs and a title.
catalog.name: knowledge_pull_requests_create

catalog.description: Get one pull request with its before/after Markdown diff and touched assets. The diff is paged; fetch every page before reviewing.
catalog.name: knowledge_pull_requests_get

catalog.description: List pull requests, optionally filtered by status (OPEN, CONFLICT, CLOSED, MERGED). Paginated: pass nextCursor back as cursor.
catalog.name: knowledge_pull_requests_list

catalog.description: Merge or close a pull request. Merging needs review permission, confirm "MERGE" and the head and target SHAs from the diff you reviewed. Closing needs confirm "CLOSE"; an author with propose access may close their own, from any of their credentials.
catalog.name: knowledge_pull_requests_review

catalog.description: Resolve a sealed-value reference found in a document into ciphertext encrypted for your approved recipient key. Plaintext is never returned.
catalog.name: knowledge_sealed_resolve

catalog.description: Hybrid full-text and semantic search over a knowledge base's indexed main branch. Returns ranked snippets with paths and citations; narrow with pathPrefix or documentId. Compare indexedCommitSha with headSha if recent edits seem missing.
catalog.name: knowledge_search

catalog.description: Filter documents by front matter: type, title, tags, a timestamp range or exact column values, optionally with a text query. Use for metadata lookups; use knowledge_search for meaning-based search.
catalog.name: knowledge_structured_search

catalog.description: Read a prepared export as base64 chunks from a byte offset. Repeat with nextOffset until eof is true.
catalog.name: knowledge_transfer_read

catalog.description: Start a chunked upload of a Markdown file or asset, declaring its kind, size, sha256 contentHash and MIME type. Returns an uploadId and the maximum chunk size. Continue with knowledge_upload_write, then knowledge_upload_finish. Never write secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) as plain text: store them as sealed values and write only the sealed reference.
catalog.name: knowledge_upload_begin

catalog.description: Finish an upload after all bytes are written; the server verifies size and hash. Then reference the uploadId from knowledge_assets_put or an assetPut change.
catalog.name: knowledge_upload_finish

catalog.description: Send the next chunk of an upload as base64 at the current byte offset. Returns the next offset.
catalog.name: knowledge_upload_write

x-kb-base64-canonical.rule: Canonical base64 (standard alphabet, length divisible by 4, exact re-encoding) whose decoded byte length is between minBytes and maxBytes inclusive.

x-kb-change-paths.rule: Each selector resolves to a list of changes ({op, path}). No path may appear twice for the same kind (assetPut/assetRemove are asset changes, every other op a document change), and no two changes other than removals (delete, assetRemove) may have the same Unicode case-folded path. A removal may share a case-folded path with any other change.

x-kb-iso-range.rule: The instants selected by the after and before selectors (selector notation) must satisfy after < before compared as exact UTC instants at the accepted fractional precision; equal instants are rejected.

x-kb-iso-utc-instant.rule: RFC 3339 UTC instant with a 4-digit year, Z offset, optional 1-9 fractional digits, and a real calendar date/time.

x-kb-json-depth-max.rule: JSON nesting depth of the value is at most this number; scalars are depth 0 and each array or object level adds one.

x-kb-json-encoded-max-bytes.rule: The UTF-8 byte length of the compact JSON encoding (JSON.stringify) of the value is at most this many bytes.

x-kb-metadata-text.rule: name rejects C0 (U+0000..U+001F) and DEL (U+007F). description follows the Markdown control policy because it is embedded in the generated index.md: C0 (including NUL, which PostgreSQL text cannot store) and DEL are rejected except tab (U+0009), line feed (U+000A) and carriage return (U+000D). Both preserve ZWJ/ZWNJ and other Unicode scalar values within their character bounds.

x-kb-no-control-chars.rule: C0 control characters other than tab (U+0009), line feed (U+000A) and carriage return (U+000D) are rejected.

x-kb-path.rule: A single kb repository path accepted by the server path normalizer: forward-slash separated clean relative path, no leading slash, no . or .. segments, no drive letters or UNC hosts, bounded length.

x-kb-path-prefix.rule: A raw document-path prefix: an x-kb-path value, optionally followed by one trailing slash (`notes/` matches only paths under the `notes` directory).

x-kb-unique-items.rule: Each selector resolves to a list; every element of that list must be pairwise distinct.

x-kb-utf8-max-bytes.rule: The UTF-8 encoding of the value is at most this many bytes.

validationContract.selectorNotation: Dot-separated object property path from the schema root; a [] segment iterates array elements (e.g. dream.upserts[].id).
validationContract.stringLengthNote: minLength and maxLength count Unicode scalar values (JSON Schema code-point semantics). The TypeScript runtime enforces exactly the same bounds by counting Unicode scalar values and rejecting unpaired surrogates, so runtime and artifact verdicts agree for every bounded string; fields whose ASCII-anchored pattern already restricts the alphabet (slug) coincide by construction. Unpaired surrogates cannot appear in server-emitted outputs because the runtime rejects them on every bounded string.
